title: KMITORA DEV Golden Migration
objective: Migrate customers, orders and order_items from the file source into PostgreSQL DEV while preserving keys, business rules and evidence.
rules: customer_id must be unique and non-empty
order_id must be unique and non-empty
item_id must be unique and non-empty
order_items.quantity must be greater than zero
customer status must be ACTIVE or INACTIVE
order status must be NEW, PAID, SHIPPED or CANCELLED
production writes are disabled unless separately authorized
reconcile row counts and referential integrity
capture evidence for every state-changing action
